item: Technical commands as prompts (e.g., 'BFS head face swap') — scores 5/10 on adherence
Claiming output is a specific medium (photograph, cinematography) when it's AI-generated — style mismatch penalizes adherence
Unstructured long prompts without clear subject/setting/style sections
Conflicting quality descriptors (8K + soft focus, hyperrealistic + painterly)
LoRA at low scale with no visible effect — wastes memory without improving quality

Plasticky/oversmoothed skin (no visible pores, artifacts 4-5) is PLATFORM-WIDE on MLX-quantized bases (zimage-moody 4-bit AND flux2-klein INT8) — NOT a LoRA side-effect. Do NOT A/B LoRAs expecting skin-realism gains on hard skin-heavy prompts.

Skin-detail levers EXHAUSTED 2026-06-20 — do NOT burn GPU re-testing: LoRA scale 0.5-0.8, steps 9-24, seed, base swap (flux2-klein has identical artifacts), realism LoRAs (Jib-Mix, Luneva). All leave artifacts at 4-5.

UltraFlux 4K VAE (app default) is 2.2x sharper than standard zimage-ae but noisier/blockier — neither clears the artifacts>=6 pore gate. VAE is NOT the skin fix. Standard zimage-ae would be softer/plasticky.
